_README.how_to_add_a_project: Copy one object from the 'projects' list below, paste it as a new entry, fill in the fields, then commit & push (Vercel auto-deploys). Newest projects look best at the top.

fields.title: Required. Project name.
fields.desc: Required. 1-2 sentence description of what it does.
fields.code: Optional. GitHub/source URL (must start with http). Omit or leave "" if none.
fields.live: Optional. Live deployment URL (must start with http). Omit or leave "" if none.
fields.status: Optional. Short badge text, e.g. "Private / Coming Soon" or "In Progress".
fields.year: Optional. Year string, e.g. "2025". Shown as a subtle label.
fields.featured: Optional. true to highlight the card (spans wider, accent border).

template.title: My New Project
template.desc: Short description of what it does and the impact.

projects.title: CtrlAI
projects.desc: Full-stack AI SaaS platform with user authentication and premium subscriptions — featuring AI-powered image processing, resume analysis, and community interaction, deployed on Vercel.

projects.title: StreamWave
projects.desc: Full-stack music streaming platform with real-time audio streaming, authentication, and playlist management — built on a polyglot persistence layer (PostgreSQL for relational data, MongoDB for content metadata, Redis for caching).

projects.title: SpeakSign — ISL Translator
projects.desc: Real-time English-to-Indian Sign Language translator using Stanza NLP to reorder grammar (SVO → SOV) across an 800+ sign SiGML lexicon, rendered through a CWASA WebGL 3D avatar with voice-input support for accessibility.

projects.title: IronMind
projects.desc: Native Android fitness tracker built with Jetpack Compose and Room (MVVM + Hilt dependency injection), with Gemini AI powering personalized workout and nutrition recommendations.

projects.title: QChat
projects.desc: Real-time chat application with instant messaging, user authentication, and media sharing — built on the MERN stack with Socket.io for live updates.
